title: Meta Makes Share Deal to Keep Zuckerberg in California
text: Meta says it will issue a new class of shares as part of a plan to keep CEO Mark Zuckerberg in California if a proposed wealth tax is passed and potentially help fund growth. The credit risk hit a record high after Meta laid out plans to boost AI spending. Alison Porter, portfolio manager for Janus Henderson's Global Technology Leaders Team, explains how the equities market are weighing these factors. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
